questions.question: Whom did God hold up as an example of faithfulness in chapter 35?
options: The faithful exiles, who continually prayed for the whole city's welfare
The Rechabites, who obeyed their forefather's command not to drink wine
The priests, who carefully kept all of the temple sacrifices
The elders, who still remembered and kept the law of Moses
questions.answer: The Rechabites, who obeyed their forefather's command not to drink wine

questions.question: What lesson did the Rechabites teach Judah?
options: That all of the faithful would be spared from the coming exile
That they kept a man's command, but Judah would not obey God
That their obedience would soon bring to them great earthly riches
That fasting from all wine pleased the LORD their God very greatly
questions.answer: That they kept a man's command, but Judah would not obey God

questions.question: God promised the Rechabites that Jonadab would never lack a man to stand before him.
The sons of the _____ have kept the command their father gave them, but this people has not obeyed me.
Jeremiah set wine before the Rechabites, but they refused to _____ it.
